page.overview:
Who is Fang?

Oerba Yun Fang is an uncontrollable guest party member in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII. She aids Lightning in battle wielding her default weapon from Final Fantasy XIII, the Bladed Lance. Fang joins Lightning's party twice, initially after Lightning joins Monoculus in the Dead Dunes and Fang asks her to open the path to the Temple Ruins. Fang will stay in Lightning's party whenever she is in the Dead Dunes until the main quest of that region is complete. She returns to aid Lightning on the final day in Luxerion Cathedral's Temple of Light, where Lightning finds her battling a Chimera and joins the fray.

Fang is not very strong compared to Lightning, but as she cannot be defeated, she works as a distraction by giving the enemies another target besides Lightning to focus on. However, her Bladed Lance is not comparable to the one Lightning can wield: Lightning acquires Fang's Bladed Lance by completing the "Last One Standing" sidequest, and when wielded by Lightning, it is the best spear in the game.

Fang has 6,000 HP in the Dead Dunes and 15,000 HP in Luxerion, though it is impossible to directly observe her stats and she cannot be KO'd in battle. Despite lacking an HP bar, she will occasionally use Mediguard. When Lightning uses Potions, Hi-Potions, X-Potions, or Nektar potions, they will apply to Fang as well. She can become afflicted with debuffs.

Fang's role is akin to that of a Commando from the rest of the Lightning Saga games, using Attack, Ruin (non-elemental magic), and Armor Breaker (extra physical damage). Usually, she will attack the same enemy as Lightning, but when fighting multiple enemies who are close together, she will attack all of them with Blitz, and sometimes use Magnet to set them up beforehand.
